name: Kairi Jo
bio: Kairi Jo, born on September 6, 2006, made her acting debut in the 2018 film Shoplifters. Gaining recognition for her acting, Kairi Jo has also worked as a voice actress in animations. As of September 2025, she is 19 years old and continues to actively pursue acting.
